notes.title: Onsui Content Update - New Modes and More!
notes.notes:
A new update hits! New content for Onsui!
Check out Implock, Daily Runs, and the other new features in this update!
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2704910/extras/onsuihold.gif?t=1734426418

New Mode - Implock
https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/2704910/extras/implock.gif?t=1734621331
Introducing the new mode Implock! In Implock, you'll have to think strategically to reach the 11th Imp rank through merging. Except, unlike the standard and Rising Overflow modes, you only drop one type of Imp!
This mode requires skilled playing to be able to methodically merge Imps together without overflowing, where you only receive 2nd rank Imps.

Daily Puzzle
Every day, get a unique and repeatable puzzle. The order of Imps you drop will be the same each time you play, and this order resets as soon as the date changes.

PATCH NOTES:

Daily Puzzle: A replayable puzzle which changes every day
Meet the Imps: Added some fluff text to the main menu to describe each of the sentient objects in the game
Score Overhaul: You can now view your highest and most recent scores from the main menu, and the scores of pieces have been tweaked
Menu: Added some new menu pages, as well as interactivity through sounds and visuals
Lighting: Tweaked the lighting to retain visuals while cutting down on the lighting calculations, which may improve your performance
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue with the sizing of the 11th Ranked Imp, as well as some other miscellaneous fixes
Lighting Improvement: Overhauled the lighting in the game to use a different system. Visual difference is extremely minor, but it may improve your performance depending on machine.
Forward Rendering: Swapped to the Forward Shading Renderer to improve VR performance and smoothness.
Blur Fix: Fixed smearing/blurring in the image that was a result of the Temporal Super Resolution effects being applied by changing the Anti-Aliasing method to FXAA.

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 16 - SANDBOX PATCH
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Thanks for checking out Onsui so far and supporting development of this project and more, you're all legends.

Here is a small patch for you guys.

 Added a custom physics option in the "Modes n' Options" menu that allows you to toggle special physics
 Can customise the bounciness/restitution of objects.
 Can customise the friction of objects.


If you're liking Onsui, remember to give it a review!
